d: After being defeated by Democrat Amy Acton in Ohio, Republican Vivek Ramaswamy says, "I have confidence that sometimes these things happen for a reason. God has a plan. We're His instruments, and I still believe that in the fullness of time, our state's best days and our country's best days will still yet be ahead of us. This is the greatest country known to the history of mankind. We are rooting for the success of the state. We are rooting for your success and that means that all of us in this room should be rooting for the success of her administration. We're hopeful for Ohio to achieve…
